messages:
Maya (Product): Hi folks — brief weird one. On my trip to Berlin I had an unplanned 8-hour layover in Frankfurt and grabbed lunch + a regional train home instead of a flight. I lost the paper receipt for the train and the cafe only gave me a digital card charge (no VAT breakdown). Total out-of-pocket ~EUR 46. Also question about per diem: policy says we can claim meals when no company meal provided; do I claim per diem for the layover or submit receipts? Lastly, I had to change the return from a red-eye to an earlier train; travel vendor charged a change fee of EUR 35 on my card. Can that be reimbursed?

Omar (People Ops): Short: if you have vendor card charge screenshots + bank statement line for the train + a short narrative, Finance can reimburse lost-receipt items up to EUR 75 with manager sign-off. Per-diem vs receipts: prefer receipts when available; per-diem is for days without receipts or for simplified daily allowance — do not double-claim. For a partial travel day (layover), claim actual meal receipts or use proportional per-diem if you choose, but be consistent.

Lena (Finance): Additions: - Train: upload bank statement showing the train charge and a screenshot of the card transaction (time, merchant). We'll accept that as substantiation for <= EUR 75 lost-receipt threshold. - Cafe: provide the card charge screenshot and note whether the cafe provided a VAT invoice; if not, we still reimburse gross. - Change fee EUR 35: reimbursable if incurred to avoid missed business commitments or because corporate card wasn't available. Upload the email from the vendor showing the fee and the booking ref.

Gabe (Manager): I approve reimbursing the train and the cafe for the layover lunch. I also approve the change fee since the earlier train avoided overnight delays and kept me in sync with the call schedule. Please include a 1-line note in the expense: "layover — business lunch + train; change fee for earlier return" and tag me for approval.

Receipt Bot: Reminder: submit within 30 days. Required uploads: bank txn screenshot, card statement snippet, booking confirmation or vendor email for fee, and manager approval comment. Use tags: "lost-receipt", "layover", "change-fee". Help: https://redwood.example/docs/expenses#lost-receipts

Maya (Product): Thanks — uploaded bank txn, screenshot of the cafe card charge (no VAT), and vendor email showing the EUR 35 fee + booking ref. Tagged Gabe. Will use receipts for the layover day rather than per-diem.
